name: Sun Shines
overview: Scripture reveals that the sun, as part of God's created order, shines impartially upon all people, reflecting His sovereign goodness and providence. From the creation of light at the beginning (Genesis 1:3) to the ongoing cycles of day and night that sustain life on earth (Genesis 8:22), God's hand is evident in the natural rhythms He established. In Matthew 5:45, Jesus emphasizes that God causes the sun to rise on both the righteous and the unrighteous, illustrating God's impartial grace and the universal provision that points to His fatherly care.
